+package ext
+
+import (
+	"fmt"
+
+	"github.com/open-policy-agent/opa/ast"
+	"github.com/open-policy-agent/opa/rego"
+	"github.com/open-policy-agent/opa/types"
+	"go.flipt.io/flipt/rpc/flipt/auth"
+)
+
+func init() {
+	rego.RegisterBuiltin2(&rego.Function{
+		Name: "flipt.is_auth_method",
+		Decl: types.NewFunction(types.Args(types.NewObject(nil, types.NewDynamicProperty(types.S, types.A)), types.S), types.B),
+	}, isAuthMethod)
+}
+
+// isAuthMethod compares the numeric authentication method in input with a
+// readable policy identifier. The enum constants keep this mapping aligned
+// with auth.proto.
+func isAuthMethod(_ rego.BuiltinContext, input, key *ast.Term) (*ast.Term, error) {
+	obj, ok := input.Value.(ast.Object)
+	if !ok {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("no authentication found")
+	}
+
+	authentication := obj.Get(ast.StringTerm("authentication"))
+	if authentication == nil {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("no authentication found")
+	}
+
+	methodName := string(key.Value.(ast.String))
+	var method auth.Method
+	switch methodName {
+	case "token":
+		method = auth.Method_METHOD_TOKEN
+	case "oidc":
+		method = auth.Method_METHOD_OIDC
+	case "kubernetes", "k8s":
+		method = auth.Method_METHOD_KUBERNETES
+	case "github":
+		method = auth.Method_METHOD_GITHUB
+	case "jwt":
+		method = auth.Method_METHOD_JWT
+	case "cloud":
+		method = auth.Method_METHOD_CLOUD
+	default:
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("unsupported auth method: %s", methodName)
+	}
+
+	authObj, ok := authentication.Value.(ast.Object)
+	if !ok {
+		return ast.BooleanTerm(false), nil
+	}
+
+	actual := authObj.Get(ast.StringTerm("method"))
+	return ast.BooleanTerm(actual != nil && actual.Equal(ast.IntNumberTerm(int(method)))), nil
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,52 @@
+package ext
+
+import (
+	"testing"
+
+	"github.com/open-policy-agent/opa/ast"
+	"github.com/open-policy-agent/opa/rego"
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
+	"go.flipt.io/flipt/rpc/flipt/auth"
+)
+
+func TestIsAuthMethod(t *testing.T) {
+	tests := []struct {
+		name   string
+		method auth.Method
+	}{
+		{"token", auth.Method_METHOD_TOKEN},
+		{"oidc", auth.Method_METHOD_OIDC},
+		{"kubernetes", auth.Method_METHOD_KUBERNETES},
+		{"k8s", auth.Method_METHOD_KUBERNETES},
+		{"github", auth.Method_METHOD_GITHUB},
+		{"jwt", auth.Method_METHOD_JWT},
+		{"cloud", auth.Method_METHOD_CLOUD},
+	}
+
+	for _, tt := range tests {
+		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			input := ast.NewTerm(ast.MustInterfaceToValue(map[string]interface{}{
+				"authentication": map[string]interface{}{"method": int(tt.method)},
+			}))
+			matched, err := isAuthMethod(rego.BuiltinContext{}, input, ast.StringTerm(tt.name))
+			require.NoError(t, err)
+			require.Equal(t, ast.BooleanTerm(true), matched)
+
+			input = ast.NewTerm(ast.MustInterfaceToValue(map[string]interface{}{
+				"authentication": map[string]interface{}{"method": int(auth.Method_METHOD_NONE)},
+			}))
+			matched, err = isAuthMethod(rego.BuiltinContext{}, input, ast.StringTerm(tt.name))
+			require.NoError(t, err)
+			require.Equal(t, ast.BooleanTerm(false), matched)
+		})
+	}
+}
+
+func TestIsAuthMethodErrors(t *testing.T) {
+	_, err := isAuthMethod(rego.BuiltinContext{}, ast.NewTerm(ast.MustInterfaceToValue(map[string]interface{}{})), ast.StringTerm("token"))
+	require.EqualError(t, err, "no authentication found")
+
+	input := ast.NewTerm(ast.MustInterfaceToValue(map[string]interface{}{"authentication": map[string]interface{}{"method": 1}}))
+	_, err = isAuthMethod(rego.BuiltinContext{}, input, ast.StringTerm("unknown"))
+	require.EqualError(t, err, "unsupported auth method: unknown")
+}

+
+	allowed, err = engine.IsAllowed(ctx, map[string]interface{}{

+	})
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	require.True(t, allowed)
+
+	allowed, err = engine.IsAllowed(ctx, map[string]interface{}{
+		"authentication": map[string]interface{}{"method": 1},
+	})
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	require.False(t, allowed)
+}
